import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,7); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# cold room box
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,1), 6, 3, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(5,2.5,'twin racks + aisle',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(5,1.7,'100mm PU panels',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# door
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4.2,1), 1.6, 2.0, fill=False, linewidth=1.5))
ax.text(5,0.7,'hinged door + seals',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# canopy posts
for x in [1.5,8.5]:
    ax.plot([x,x],[0.5,5.8],'k-',linewidth=2)
ax.text(1.5,0.3,'post anchor',ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.text(8.5,0.3,'post anchor',ha='center',fontsize=7)
# PV roof tilted
ax.plot([1,9],[5.8,6.5],'k-',linewidth=3)
ax.plot([1,9],[5.5,6.2],'k-',linewidth=1)
ax.text(5,6.7,'4kW tilted PV shade roof',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.annotate('vent gap', xy=(5,5.7), xytext=(8.8,5.0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'), fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('ice bank under evaporator', xy=(6.5,3.5), xytext=(8.8,3.8), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'), fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150); plt.close()
